sentences.text:
Vikram Sharma .....Peti
 Versus
 State Of Punjab And Anr .....

Resp
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Vashisth.

Present: Mr. Harminder Singh, Advocate, and
 Mr. Damanjeet Singh, Advocate, for the petitione
Mr. Neeraj Madaan, Sr. Dag, Punjab.

Present petition has been filed for quashing and setting aside the order dated 24.07.2023 (Annexure P-9) passed by learned JMIC, whereby non-bailable warrants have been issued against the petitioner, in FIR No.14 dated 05.02.2021, under Sections 420, 506 and 120-B of IPC, registered at PS Division No.2, Pathankot, as well as subsequent orders dated 19.08.2023 (Annexure P-10) and 28.09.2023 (Annexure P-11), whereby fresh non-bailable warrants have been issued against the petitioner, and all other consequential proceedings arising therefrom.
2.

On the very outset, counsel for the petitioner informs the Court that during the pendency of present petition, both the parties, i.e. petitioner and members of the complainant/victim(s) party have resolved the dispute, and resultantly, FIR in question and all other consequential proceedings have been quashed, vide order dated 24.09.2025 passed in CRM-M-35636-2024.
Copy of the said order has been produced in the Court by counsel for the petitioner, and same is ordered to be taken on record.
Registry is directed to tag the same at the appropriate place on the file.
4. In view of the said fact, present petition stands disposed of, as the same having been rendered infructuous.
5. Pending miscellaneous application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of.
